verdict.rationale: The only route for scans to leave the platform is a marketing-level claim that APIs connect the mailbox to other tools so 'documents and mail stay in sync' [docs-11, docs-1], alongside cloud access to digital copies [docs-12]. That implies documents can flow out, but nothing describes a bulk export of PDFs or mail-history metadata. missing for 10: an explicit bulk export feature, documented export of mail history and metadata (sender, dates, actions), API documentation showing scans can be fully extracted, and independent or hands-on confirmation that data can leave on account closure.
